slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: A continental monitoring report (October 2016 round) giving per-country results only as score bands. For South Sudan it states: the only responding country with no legal provision for birth and death registration; digitization of the civil registration system scored under 35 per cent, with 20 other countries; overall CRVS system under 35 per cent. It does not state for South Sudan by name whether local offices capture records electronically or on paper, so no listed value is stated and no system is named.
